description: Pixels per inch of any screen from its resolution and size, with dot pitch and real width. A HelpySelf tool (helpyself.com).

diagonal.description: The screen's diagonal size, as advertised, in diagonalUnit. Defaults to 27 (inches).

diagonalUnit.description: Unit of the diagonal: "in" (inches, how screens are sold) or "cm".

height.description: Vertical resolution in pixels. Defaults to 1440.

width.description: Horizontal resolution in pixels. Defaults to 2560.
